basics.name: Tingzhu Bi
basics.label: PhD Candidate, Peking University
basics.summary: PhD candidate at Peking University working on accountable LLM agents for reasoning and complex-system diagnosis, dynamic causal discovery, and AIOps. Research grounded in real hyperscale production data through a long-running collaboration with ByteDance. Expected graduation: 2027.

education.area: School of Computer Science and Technology

work.name: ByteDance
work.summary: Research on metric causal-relationship discovery and dynamic fault-propagation networks over ByteDance's hyperscale (million-host) data centers, supporting the intelligent-operations platform. Led to FaultInsight (KDD'24).
highlights: Deep causal fault diagnosis over heterogeneous host-level metrics
Industry collaboration on real production incident data

work.name: ByteDance
work.position: iOS Developer Intern, Lark iOS (Enterprise Service – Lark – iOS)
work.summary: Contributed to the refactor of the Lark Feed page, focusing on first-screen load time and scrolling smoothness. My algorithmic improvement passed performance-evaluation acceptance and was merged into the production release.

publications.name: Not Until the Evidence Says So: Teaching LLM Investigators When to Close a Case
publications.summary: Studies when an LLM investigator should close a case versus leave it open and name what is missing; introduces Nautil (731 audited cases across aviation, rail, maritime, chemical-safety, vehicle-defect reports and production server incidents) and a three-part closure evaluation; fine-tuning plus closure-only RL makes a 9B model's closures follow the evidence.

publications.name: JustDiag: A Diagnostic Justification Engine for Accountable Root Cause Analysis
publications.summary: A diagnostic justification engine that maintains an explicit, auditable process state over evidence, hypotheses, and conflicts; evaluated on 66 real-world incidents with a two-layer outcome/process protocol.

publications.name: CAVIAR: Disentangling Root Causes with an ICA-based VAE for Large-Scale Microservice Systems
publications.summary: ICA-based variational autoencoder that disentangles independent causal factors to improve root-cause identification in large-scale microservice systems. (Co-author.)

publications.name: UnCLe: Towards Scalable Dynamic Causal Discovery in Non-linear Temporal Systems
publications.publisher: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
publications.summary: Uncoupler-Recoupler representation disentanglement with temporal-perturbation analysis to recover time-resolved dynamic causal graphs; outperforms SOTA on static benchmarks while capturing evolving causality.

publications.name: G-Cause: Parameter-free Global Diagnosis for Hyperscale Web Service Infrastructures
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Web Services (ICWS)
publications.summary: Parameter-free global fault diagnosis across hyperscale web-service infrastructures. (Co-author.)

publications.name: FaultInsight: Interpreting Hyperscale Data Center Host Faults
publications.summary: Interpretable deep causal framework for host-fault diagnosis over heterogeneous host-level metrics; multi-perspective diagnostic insights validated on real ByteDance production incidents.

publications.name: HEAL: Performance Troubleshooting Deep inside Data Center Hosts
publications.summary: Performance troubleshooting deep inside data-center hosts via heterogeneous host-level signals. (Co-author.)

publications.name: VECROsim: A Versatile Metric-oriented Microservice Fault Simulation System
publications.summary: Open, customizable microservice fault-simulation system and benchmark dataset providing a standardized data foundation for fault-diagnosis and causal research.
